mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 1.0% signals monetary tightening that increases corporate borrowing costs, reducing earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 1.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering corporate revenue revisions downward and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 4.5% indicates tight labor market conditions that drive wage inflation, prompting Federal Reserve rate hikes and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 signals expanding manufacturing output, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >50% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing near-term corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >50% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) and unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) signal dual monetary tightening and labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% AND UNRATE > 4.5%, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Post-Fed hiking cycle (FEDFUNDS > 1.0% sustained) leads to market stabilization and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as economic adjustments occur.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >50% of periods in post-hiking cycle regime, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
